names.name: Yum Yum Donut Shops
names.said: A Los Angeles chain most of the country has never heard of.

text.what: A Southern California donut chain, and since 2004 the owner of Winchell's.
text.story: Yum Yum Donut Shops, Inc. bought Winchell's in 2004, putting two of the West's older chains under one owner.
text.today: Two chains, one company, in a region where most shops belong to families.
